markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (93%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and high reliability, but the second model disagrees and only 2 of 5 neighbors match [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 93%, InSitu 4%, Normal 3% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 percentile | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scarce here; below typical · Validated [F2]
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score, but concept untrustworthy · Unreliable [F3]
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 9) · ↓ invasive · Abundant; above typical · Validated [F4]
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Present; text-prompt score only · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect classifier. Mitotic figures are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG degradation (severity 3) distorted features both models read.
- The MUSK model's different top class is right; 3 of 5 neighbors are Normal.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 6** — only region pushing toward invasive; recheck TIL and necrosis, both poorly validated.
2. **Regions 0, 8** — highest per-region invasive risk (22%, 33%); confirm benign stroma and nuclei.
3. **Region 5** — confirm ducts are benign, not in-situ; duct-confined spot check only 12/20.
